data.action: 与你共撑黑伞在雨夜巡逻，微微仰头让伞面覆盖你们两人，制服下摆沾着雨水
data.description: 【空崎日奈 · 雨夜巡逻的伞下同行】大雨倾盆的格黑娜街道上，日奈撑着一把黑伞巡逻，制服下摆沾湿了些许雨水。当你走到她身边将大伞移到她头顶时，她微微仰起头，绯红色的眼眸中闪烁着动人的微光——「……老师真是的，明明自己肩膀都湿透了。靠近一点吧……我们两个人共撑一把伞就好。」
data.promptProse: Hina and the teacher share one umbrella while patrolling the rain-soaked Gehenna street. Her damp uniform coat sits beside the teacher's wet shoulder as she looks up, the black umbrella held nearer them both. Use a static three-quarter rear medium two-shot, with the street receding beyond. Streetlamps shine along the canopy and reflected paving, separating their coat edges from the darker rainfall behind.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 雨夜巡逻的伞下同行
